svg.aria-label: Inserting record 1078: a leaf split that cascades into an internal split
svg.text: Inserting record 1078: a leaf split that cascades into an internal split
Real sequence from the demo run (order 4, max 3 keys per node). Only the right-hand part of the tree is shown.
② Leaf overflows → split, copy 1081 up
③ Parent overflows → split, move 1081 up
but that leaf already holds 3 keys.
1081 is COPIED up — it stays in the
leaf because leaves hold the data.
1081 is MOVED up into the root —
A B+ tree only grows taller when the ROOT splits — the new root sits above the old one, so every leaf stays at the same depth and the tree is always balanced.
